items.title: Frank Carter Curses Out Man Who Crashed Women-Only Sex Pistols Mosh Pit
items.summary: This is the world we live in: there's always one asshole. There's always one person who's holding the world back from peace or equality or common human decency and universal respect. On Friday, that one asshole existed at the Sex Pistols gig, featuring Frank Carter, at Denver, CO's Ogden Theatre, who had a problem with a women-centric mosh pit. items.title: Rosalía Brings Lux To SNL, Appears In Sketch About Jelly Roll Playing Sphere
items.summary: Last night (Oct. 10), Rosalía was the musical guest with Shane Gillis as host on SNL . It was nice to see the angelic pop star return; she last performed on the show in March 2022 and joined Bad Bunny's performance in 2021. She sang "Reliquia" and "Magnolias" from her excellent 2025 album Lux . Both were absolutely stunning; she sang the former en pointe and the latter under rain (which is on trend ). items.title: MJ Lenderman Debuts New Music At Good Moon Festival
items.summary: MJ Lenderman played his first concert in five months in Durham, NC last night. His joint performances with Waxahatchee ran through May and the following month he dropped off Zach Bryan's tour for a well-deserved break, though he did play with Wednesday bandmate Karly Hartzman and Brad Cook at Tracey Nelson's popup show in the same city in July.
